wayfix.option.title: WayFix Options
wayfix.option.autoScaleGUI.tooltip: Auto-scales the GUI scale depending on your display's scaling.
wayfix.option.autoScaleGUI.tooltip2: (e.g. 2 GUI Scale on 1920x1080 at 100% → 4 GUI Scale on 3840x2160 at 200%)
wayfix.option.injectIcon.tooltip: Injects the Minecraft Icon at Startup instead of defaulting to the normal Wayland icon.
wayfix.option.keyModifiersFix.tooltip: Fixes issues where keyboard combinations like 'CTRL + A' or 'CTRL + C' are sent as characters in chat instead of being recognized as key combinations.
wayfix.option.monitorName.tooltip: Full-screens the minecraft window in the selected monitor.
wayfix.option.monitorName.tooltip2: By default Minecraft sometimes full-screens on the wrong monitor due to Wayland limitations.
wayfix.option.monitorName.tooltip3: Leave empty to use primary monitor.
wayfix.option.kdotoolWarning.tooltip: Show a warning if kdotool is not installed in console.
wayfix.toast.restart-game.title: WayFix: Restart your game!
wayfix.toast.restart-game.description: The early loading screen has been disabled.
